subject: ArmVirtPkg: ArmCcaRsiLib: Add interfaces to manage the Realm IPA state
reasons: This commit adds new functions (ArmCcaRsiGetIpaState and ArmCcaRsiSetIpaState) and new type definitions to ArmCcaRsiLib. It is entirely new code addition, not a transformation of existing patterns.
Coccinelle operates on existing code to match and transform; it cannot be used to add new API functions or data types.
The change extends an existing library with new RSI interface wrappers, which is a new feature addition not expressible as a SmPL transformation.
